conditions.evidence: pediatric patients with a primary anxiety disorder
conditions.label: anxiety disorder

modalities.evidence: two task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) scans
demographic variables, clinical symptoms reported by clinicians, self, and parent

output.population: Treatment-seeking pediatric patients with a primary anxiety disorder (n = 121) and healthy volunteer youth (n = 90)
output.summary: Randomized controlled trial dataset pairing demographic and clinician-, self- and parent-reported clinical measures with two dot-probe fMRI scans in youth with anxiety disorders and healthy volunteers, around CBT plus gamified attention bias modification training.
